name: tangential wheel–rail creep forces
definition_zh: 轮轨滚动接触中由切向蠕滑产生的相互作用力。
definition_en: The tangential interaction forces associated with wheel–rail creepage.
scope_note: 蠕滑力与蠕滑率分别表示作用力和相对滑动的运动学量；本词条讨论轮轨接触中的切向力。
usage_overview: 用于描述车辆—轨道动力学中的切向接触作用，相关模型可采用线性蠕滑理论计算并作非线性修正。它表示作用力，应与表征相对滑动的运动学量蠕滑率区分。

complete_examples.text: The tangential wheel–rail creep forces are first calculated using Kalker’s linear creep theory and modified by the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [20].

The wheel/rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified with the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [31] .
